description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of twelve distinct subject categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, category labels and their corresponding percentages are positioned outside the pie and connected to their respective slices via thin grey leader lines. Proceeding clockwise from the top right, the segments include AI/NLP Research in blue (24.3%), Business in red (5.9%), Geography in gold (2.7%), Math in green (1.2%), Game&Anime in dark orange (8.2%), Econ. & Fin. in teal (18.4%), Science in light blue (6.7%), Law in coral (5.1%), History in yellow (8.2%), Med & Health in light green (6.7%), Pet & Animal in light orange (5.5%), and Daily Life in light cyan (7.1%). The slices are not arranged in any discernible order based on size, and none of the segments are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
